name: logbook
description: Logbook: a private journal and personal OS. Web app, server, and Android app.

scripts.android:init: npm run build && npx cap add android && python3 scripts/android_widget.py && npm run android:icons
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
